step: Fresh Team route finishes with Start together focused
snapshot:
- main:
  - link "REVEAL LINE":
    - /url: ../
    - text: REVEAL
    - generic: LINE
  - text: COUCH CO-OP
  - generic: RELAY YARD
  - link "Race mode ↗":
    - /url: ./
  - region "Find your common ground.":
    - paragraph: ONE ARENA. TWO PARTNERS.
    - heading "Find your common ground." [level=1]:
      - text: Find your
      - emphasis: common ground.
    - paragraph: Start with a small loop. Cover each other, then meet to join a larger cut.
    - text: Arena
    - combobox "Arena":
      - option "First Connection · territory challenge"
      - option "Relay Yard · stronghold challenge" [selected]
    - text: Play style
    - combobox "Play style":
      - option "Full teamwork" [selected]
      - option "Joint Cuts + ordinary cover"
      - option "Individual cuts + ordinary cover"
    - text: Challenge
    - combobox "Challenge":
      - option "Gentle"
      - option "Standard" [selected]
      - option "Expert"
    - paragraph: Captures recharge both players’ Support and can rescue a downed partner.
    - paragraph: One open field. Bait a Hunter, cover the crossing, then take the anchors together.
    - button "Start together →" [active]
    - paragraph:
      - status: Two players · one screen · a shared victory
    - generic "Play a created co-op pack"
    - complementary "Help and options":
      - generic "How to play and controls"
      - generic "Options"
      - option "Auto · touch players without a controller" [selected]
      - option "Show both players"
      - option "Hide touch controls"
    - paragraph: TAKE THE STRONGHOLD TOGETHER
    - list:
      - strong: Start small.
      - text: Draw a short loop back to safe ground to claim it. Banking stops your craft; steer again for your next cut.
      - strong: Join when ready.
      - text: Steer both moving heads together to bank a shared cut. Crossing an old part of a partner’s line is harmless.
      - strong: Watch the red shapes.
      - text: Enemies can hit your craft and unfinished line. Hunters mark a route before charging. Wait for recovery or use Support to protect the crossing. Both approaches face the same enemy tools.
      - strong: Cover each other.
      - text: Tap Support to slow nearby enemies and intercept sparks. A dashed ring marks an enemy while it is slowed. Hold Support beside a downed partner for one second to rescue them for free.
      - strong: Open both approaches.
      - text: Capture anchors A and B to expose the core. Then make a new cut that captures the core itself. The shield blocks entry. Bait the Hunter’s warning and cut during recovery; banking its cell clears it.
    - paragraph:
      - text: TEAM OBJECTIVE
      - strong: Capture both anchors, then the exposed core

    - generic: Support ready

    - strong: 0.0%
    - generic: 3 reserves
    - progressbar "Team territory"
    - generic: "2"
    - strong: SKYLINE
    - generic: On safe ground
    - generic: Support ready
    - paragraph: Capture the shield anchors · 0 / 2 secured
    - img "One shared arena. Sunflower is marked 1 and Skyline is marked 2." [active]
    - status: Watch the Hunter warnings. Cover a crossing or join after the charge passes.
    - generic: 0:00
    - button "Pause"
